name: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1943, The Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Ltd is an Agro-Processing company that manufactures starch & its derivatives[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SSCL is a part of the Sardana family and associates. The company primarily manufactures starch, its derivatives, and 
 other by-products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.0% over last 3 years.
